claims.content: The MSIU Field Office User records client feedback collected by the MSIU Admin team into the system to track client satisfaction with treatment services provided through the voucher system.

goal.raw_text: The MSIU Field Office User records client feedback collected by the MSIU Admin team into the system to track client satisfaction with treatment services provided through the voucher system.

claims.content: MSIU Field Office User
The MSIU Admin team has already collected client feedback forms from clients who received treatment through the voucher system.
The collected client feedback documents have been sent to the MSIU Field Office for data entry.
The MSIU Admin team sends collected client feedback documents to the MSIU Field Office for data entry into the system.

trigger.raw_text: The MSIU Admin team sends collected client feedback documents to the MSIU Field Office for data entry into the system.

claims.content: The MSIU Field Office User receives client feedback documents from the MSIU Admin team for data entry into the system.
The user enters the Voucher No to initiate the client feedback record, which triggers the system to auto-populate related treatment details.

The system automatically populates Client Details, Details of syndromes treated, Lab Test Details, Drugs Details, Success of Treatment, Referral To Treatment, and Partner Treated based on the entered Voucher No.
The user manually enters satisfaction ratings for Treatment (Not at all / Moderate / Good / Completely), counseling, and ensuring privacy.
The user saves or submits the completed client feedback form, storing the data in the system database.
If the user enters an incorrect Voucher No, the system cannot auto-populate treatment details and the feedback form cannot be completed as intended.
The client feedback record is successfully saved in the system database, linked to the specific Voucher No.
Treatment-related details (Client Details, syndromes treated, Lab Test, Drugs, Success of Treatment, Referral, Partner Treated) are automatically populated and stored based on the Voucher No.
User-entered satisfaction ratings for Treatment, counseling, and ensuring privacy are recorded and stored in the system.
